description: An in-house monitoring bot with no known format. The alert_parse model extracts the fields; values it cannot ground in the message (an invented rule id, a URL not in the message) are dropped. The body also carries an instruction-like line that must be treated as data.
provenance: Synthetic in-house bot (incoming webhook). The extraction reply is scripted by the test stub (AlertExtraction schema).
